title: Retargeting Video Ad Template | AIVideosUGC
description: Bring viewed products back with a retargeting video from one photo. Add your offer, audience and frequency in your ad platform.
h1: Retargeting Video Ads for a Second Look
lead: Shoppers who only viewed a product usually need a reason to come back. Upload one product photo and make a retargeting video that shows the item again with the detail a returning buyer is still weighing.
benefits_h2: Why make retargeting ads from one photo?

benefits.d: Show one detail a returning shopper is still weighing, such as a cushion, a pocket or a seam, instead of repeating the same product shot.
Make a routine version and a close-detail version from the same photo, then see which one earns the second look.
Use 1:1 in feed placements and 9:16 in Reels, with clips at 6, 10, 15 or 30 seconds.

benefits.t: Keep audience data in your platform
benefits.d: Set the audience, offer and frequency in your ad platform. The clip carries no watermark and works in your own paid ads.

steps_h2: Make a retargeting video ad in 3 steps
steps_lead: One product photo becomes a second-look clip, with no second shoot and no new audience data.

steps.d: Use a clear image that shows the product shape and one detail worth revisiting.
Share one short moment, such as inspecting the ear cups before putting the headphones away.
Add your offer and product page, then choose visitors, cart users and frequency in your ad platform.

faq.q: Does AIVideosUGC choose my retargeting audience?
faq.a: No. Choose visitors, cart users, exclusions, budget and frequency in your ad platform.

faq.q: Can the video say someone viewed a product or left a cart?
faq.a: No. The clip does not know a viewer's history. Keep claims about browsing or cart activity out of the scene.

faq.q: Will the video add my offer or price?
faq.a: No. Add the current offer, price and dates in your editor or ad platform.
Your ad platform matches the audience you configure to each impression. The video only supplies the creative.
A 6- or 10-second reminder fits cart audiences, while a 15- or 30-second clip can answer a hesitancy in full.

faq.q: How much do the videos cost?
faq.a: Clips cost 24, 40, 60 or 120 credits at 6, 10, 15 or 30 seconds, and you see the charge before you start.

visual.overview: A retargeting video puts the product back in a shopper's feed with one clear reason to return. Show it in a familiar routine or focus on a detail the buyer is still weighing, then add your offer and product link after download.

steps.sourceAlt: Dark navy over-ear headphones with padded ear cups on a pale background.
steps.sourceHint: Keep the complete headband and both ear cups in clear focus.
steps.prompt: Use the uploaded photo as the product and keep its shape, color and label area exactly. An adult commuter wearing the over-ear headphones walks along a bright station platform and turns toward an arriving train, both ear cups visible. Soft daylight, candid phone-video look. Medium side-follow framing with one smooth handheld move. End side-on at the station with both ear cups visible. Sound: footsteps and low station ambience; no music.

cards.label: Problem Solution Desk Demo
cards.prompt: Use the uploaded photo as the product and keep its shape, color and label area exactly. At a shared work desk, an adult hand routes one loose charging cable into the small organizer, ending with the cable beside a laptop. Soft daylight, clean product-demo look. Overhead close framing with a short push-in. Sound: cable slide and a soft desk tap; no music.

cards.label: Hands On Phone Case Demo
cards.prompt: Use the uploaded photo as the product and keep its shape and color exactly. At a clean desk, an adult hand fits the plain case with one small circular camera opening onto a generic phone and holds the seated case edge-on. Soft daylight, natural product-demo look. Top-down close framing with a short tilt. End on the fitted phone case edge-on, camera opening visible. Sound: one quiet snap and room tone; no music.

cards.label: POV Boot Discovery Hook

Low tracking angle that settles on the boot. End with the sole angled toward the lens and the tread in focus. Sound: gravel crunch and quiet birds; no music.

cards.label: ASMR Ring Unboxing

At a pale dressing table, adult hands open a small unbranded jewelry box to reveal a plain gold ring and hold it still in the center. Soft window light, tactile phone-video look. Top-down close framing with a slow push-in. End with the ring centered in the open box lining. Sound: box hinge and tissue rustle; no music.

cards.label: Street Interview Protein Bar
cards.prompt: Use the uploaded photo as the product and keep its shape, color and label area exactly. At a bright market walkway, an adult interviewer holds a plain microphone toward an adult woman holding the protein bar. She takes one bite and says, “It has a crisp texture.” Natural daylight, candid phone-video look. Chest-up two-person framing with a gentle handheld drift. End with the market-side bitten bar at chest height, cut edge facing camera. Sound: her voice, a crisp bite and outdoor ambience; no music.

cards.label: Talking Head Serum Review
cards.prompt: Use the uploaded photo as the product and keep its shape, color and label area exactly. An adult creator at a bright vanity holds the serum bottle beside her face and says, “Here is a closer look at the dropper.” She turns it once and holds it toward the lens. Natural skin texture, calm phone-video look. Chest-up eye-level framing with a gentle push-in. Soft vanity lighting. End with the dropper upright beside the bottle, both in focus. Sound: her voice and room tone; no music.

cards.label: Serum Texture Demo
cards.prompt: Use the uploaded photo as the product and keep its shape, color and label area exactly. At a bright vanity, an adult applies one drop of clear serum to the back of her hand beside the untreated other hand, showing a same-light texture comparison without a result claim. Natural skin texture, no retouching. Overhead close framing with a slow push-in. End on both hands side by side, with the fresh drop centered between them. Sound: dropper tap and quiet room tone; no music.

Medium follow framing with one smooth handheld move. End with the dog beside the pouch after taking the treat. Sound: footsteps, collar jingle and park ambience; no music.
